def kernel (a b c d : Fin 9) : ℤ :=
  1 + delta a b + delta a c + delta a d +
    delta b c + delta b d + delta c d +

    delta a d * delta b c +
    2 * (delta a b * delta a c + delta a b * delta a d +
      delta a c * delta a d + delta b c * delta b d) +
    6 * delta a b * delta a c * delta a d
